title: Independent SFT Dataset Semantic and Integrity Audit

Audit of RAGTruth spans, metadata, and empirical census of conflict vs baseless info records
Detailed comparison of sft_v1 targets against TrustRAG G3 five-outcome decision semantics
Field completeness, truncation checks, input-target leakage scan, and duplicate triplet analysis

Definitive readiness verdicts and recommendations across five distinct ML training objectives
